oliver: quick heads-up - NorthLeaf wants a co-sell POC. Scope: secure onboarding, EU data residency, pricing delta for reserved vs hosted, and a joint deployment diagram. They asked for a demo week starting Jul 8. Who can pick owners? :wave:

maria: I can own the Security Questionnaire (SecQ) and cert bundle. Need partner contact and their data classification form. I'll ask InfoSec to fast-track review. :+1:

sam: I'll draft the joint architecture and runbook. Preference question: do we propose VPC peering or Private deployment first? Also will add canary routing and rollback steps.

oliver: timeline: SecQ draft by Mon EOD, arch + runbook by Tue, pricing ballpark today if possible. Partner PM is Cara - I'll DM contact info.

maria: SecQ priority items: EU residency controls, KMS/customer-managed key support, log retention/redaction, and SOC2/ISO certs. I'll also request a signed attestation about PII in telemetry.

sam: initial arch bullets:

```
- Partner app in eu-central-1 VPC
- Option A: VPC peering to Redwood Private control plane + Dedicated GPU pool in same region
- Option B: Private deployment image in partner infra for strict residency
- Auth: SAML SSO + SCIM; exchange IdP metadata
- KMS: CMK required for persisted artifacts
- Network: egress-only from partner -> Redwood, strict ACLs
- Rollout: 5% canary -> monitor -> scale to 100%
```

sam: I'll export a PNG and short SVG for the diagram. Anything else to call out?

infra-bot: Peering checklist: https://redwood.internal/checklists/peering (internal) :link:

maria: On logs: partner says no PII, but we need a signed attestation and DLP controls. I'll add DLP section to SecQ and ask Legal for a DPA addendum for EU residency.

oliver: Pricing ask: can we give a simple reserved vs hosted delta? If so, include committed monthly for their projected 180 QPS and token unit cost. Flag private deployment as a higher-cost option.

sam: For the runbook I'll include sample commands for canary route + rollback (example):

```
redwood routes create --name northleaf-canary --match "header:partner-id=\"northleaf\"" --model oss-13b-quant4 --pool dedicated-eu-1 --traffic 0.05
redwood routes update --name northleaf-canary --traffic 0  # rollback
```

oliver: Action items summary: maria = SecQ + cert bundle + DPA loop, sam = arch + runbook + diagrams, oliver = partner comms & legal loop, pricing TBD (who can do ballpark?)

maria: I'll loop Legal once SecQ draft is ready. ETA Mon 09:00 UTC if InfoSec approves.

sam: I can mock a quick pricing sensitivity note by EOD: assumptions: avg request 420 tokens, steady 150 QPS, peak 220 QPS, recommend int4 quant to reduce token cost.

oliver: Perfect. If any blocker (peering approvals, legal certs), ping me immediately. I'll schedule a quick partner sync after we have artifacts. Thanks all :thumbsup:
